description: This file contains the 'Online' model class for the admin report module in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to retrieve online customer records and their total count from the database, with support for filtering by IP address and customer name.
external_files: SQL constants or definitions like DB_PREFIX

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Model class handling retrieval of online customer data for reports in the admin area of OpenCart.

methods.name: getOnline
methods.description: Fetches a list of online customer records from the database, filtered by optional criteria such as IP and customer name, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalOnline
methods.description: Returns the total number of online customer records matching optional filter criteria.
